optimizedDescription.value: ResolveSchema deterministically composes base, extends, plugins, overrides, templates, and validation into one resolved Schema.

optimizedContext.value:
# ResolveSchema

## Rules
- Construct with SchemaRegistry, schemaRef, workspaceSchemasPaths, schemaPlugins[], optional schemaOverrides; `execute()` takes no arguments, returns `Promise<Schema>`.
- Pipeline: resolve base or `SchemaNotFoundError`; recursively resolve extends with path-cycle detection; build root→parent extends layers; inherit parent compat unless child overrides; resolve plugins in declaration order, require kind schema-plugin; recursively normalize override hooks from YAML to domain across append/prepend/create/set; merge layers; pre-build inherited base when plugins/overrides exist for error attribution; final `buildSchema`.
- Layers order: extends → plugins → override; sources preserved. Plugin miss hard error; kind mismatch/cycle → `SchemaValidationError`.
- Final ref is original schemaRef without layers, otherwise `<schemaRef> (resolved)`. Templates accumulate across extends; child same-path template wins.
- Registry result exposes parsed YAML, templates, resolved path. Execution idempotent/deterministic.
- Config factory uses `resolveResolveSchemaDeps(resolver)` then canonical `createResolveSchema(deps)`; helper resolves schemas/schemaRef/plugins/overrides and owns config-based composition.

## Constraints
- Application use case only; imports domain merge/build services and SchemaRegistry port, never infrastructure.
- Extends depth unlimited; cycles detected by resolved path.
- Factory never reconstructs fs wiring inline.
